position.interpretation: flip_rate is the share of pairs where swapping the order changed the winner. 0.0 = no position bias, 0.5 = coin toss.

length.interpretation: rho between reply length in tokens and the axis score. |rho| > 0.4 suggests the judge is partly measuring length.

self_preference.interpretation: positive delta = the judge scores its own model's replies higher on identical inputs. Both models share a provider, so this is a WEAKER separation than a different family would give.

groundedness.verdict: WEAK: below 0.6. Judge-based reply-quality differences are weak evidence and must not be reported as findings without human confirmation.

actionability.verdict: acceptable: judge-based deltas are suggestive, not conclusive
